manual.title: Enter an address
manual.description: Use this when the device is on another VLAN or subnet, where discovery broadcasts do not reach.

abort.already_configured: That device is already set up.

reconfigure.title: Edit command
reconfigure.description: Renaming or moving keeps the same entity, so dashboards and automations are unaffected. Tick Learn again to replace the code while keeping everything else.

data_description.repeats: Extra times the code is sent per press. Leave at 0 for most things. Some receivers, fan motors especially, only react when the code arrives several times in a row; try 5.
data_description.frequency: Found by scanning, and normally best left alone. If the command does not work, check the figure printed on the remote and correct it here, then tick Learn again. Clearing it scans from scratch.

user.title: What kind of remote?
user.description: Infrared is used by TVs, air conditioners and most home electronics. Radio frequency is used by blinds, awnings, gates and doorbells.

failed.title: Nothing was captured
failed.description: The device stopped listening before a code arrived. Hold the remote closer and try again.

name.title: Name this command
name.description: Tick Test to send the code and check it does what you expect. Leave it unticked to save. {result}

data_description.repeats: Extra times the code is sent per press. Leave at 0 for most things. Some receivers, fan motors especially, only react when the code arrives several times in a row; try 5.

progress.learn_ir: Point the remote at the device and press the button once.
progress.hold_rf: Press and hold the button until this step finishes, so the device can find the right frequency. If your remote stops transmitting while held, tap it repeatedly instead.
progress.press_rf: Press the button once. Press it again every few seconds until this step finishes.

send_failed.message: Could not reach the Broadlink device.
